landing.heroBody: A safe, mobile-first learning companion for Grade 4 to 7, built around the South African curriculum — in your child's language.
landing.featuresTitle: Everything your child needs to feel confident at school
landing.feature.grades.title: Grade 4-7, South African curriculum
landing.feature.grades.body: Lessons and practice aligned to what your child is actually learning in class this term.
landing.feature.languages.title: Learns in the language your child understands
landing.feature.languages.body: English and Afrikaans at launch, with all 11 official languages built into the foundation.
landing.feature.lessons.title: Animated, visual lessons
landing.feature.lessons.body: Short, friendly explanations with visuals — not walls of text.
landing.feature.tutor.title: A tutor, not a chatbot
landing.feature.tutor.body: Guides your child to understand, never just hands over answers.
landing.feature.scan.title: Homework help from a photo
landing.feature.scan.body: Snap a worksheet and get a simplified explanation and practice questions.
landing.feature.exam.title: Exam preparation
landing.feature.exam.body: Revision plans, mock tests and a readiness score before the big day.
landing.feature.progress.title: Progress you can see
landing.feature.progress.body: A parent dashboard showing strengths, weak spots, and what to focus on next.
landing.feature.safety.title: Built for child safety
landing.feature.safety.body: No chat with strangers, no public profiles, no social feed — ever.
landing.disclaimer: Study supports learning; it does not guarantee improved marks.
landing.footer.tagline: A safe, curriculum-aligned learning companion for South African families.
